title: Ada and the Machine
author: Wren Pemberton
blurb: Lior Sterling, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
